title: </sub>  Keep finding titles out of sweep logs
text:
</sub>  Keep finding titles out of sweep logs

Adding `title` to `SweepFindingAttribution` also sends every title through the shared `sweep_pass_record` log event, including for superseded passes or publication failures where the finding was never public. Model-generated titles can repeat PR content, while the parser only redacts the limited sensitive-literal patterns it recognizes; this conflicts with the spec's requirement that logs contain non-sensitive counts and never credential values. Use the stable finding index plus category identifiers for the logged mapping, and render titles only on an appropriate user-facing or evidence surface if needed.
